explanation: The serialization logic for mapped operators was inverted: `include_deps=op.deps is MappedOperator.deps_for(BaseOperator)` (include when using default deps) was changed to `include_deps=op.deps != MappedOperator.deps_for(BaseOperator)` (include when NOT using default deps), which reverses when deps are serialized and could cause mapped sensors to lose their `ReadyToRescheduleDep` during serialization/deserialization.
